scientific_integrity: An analytical theorem for finite irreducible reversible resident Markov generators; the spectral proof covers all permitted finite sizes. Exact rational tests independently check selected instances and a sharp example, without claiming finite tests are a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: One patch, full replacement, externally specified constant invader pressure, exponential extinction, reversibility. Independent validation and historical-priority assessment have not been performed; Pakes full technical text was inaccessible.
title: A single-dip law for patch occupancy under competitive replacement
